hooks.command: python3 "$FACTORY_PROJECT_DIR/.loki/loki.py" protect --harness factory || { printf '%s\n' 'loki: hook command failed' >&2; exit 2; }
python3 "$FACTORY_PROJECT_DIR/.loki/loki.py" context --root "$FACTORY_PROJECT_DIR" --event SessionStart || { printf '%s\n' 'loki: context unavailable' >&2; exit 2; }
